entities.summary: Adolphe Vuitry was a French lawyer, economist, and politician. He became recognized as an expert on finance. He was governor of the Banque de France from 1863 to 1864, then Minister-President of the Conseil d'Etat from 1864 to 1869. In his later years he devoted himself to historical studies, publishing many works on medieval and modern finance.
